source.note: Scan without a text layer. Unlike the 2025 papers the PDF includes the cover (printed page 1), the instructions (page 2) and the information sheet; PDF page n = printed page n. Source file and hash are recorded in sources/maths/manifest.json. Duration 3 hours as printed on the cover.

extraction.method: manual transcription from 170 dpi page renders, checked at 300 dpi where needed

questions.text_md: $3x^{2}-2x=6$  (answers correct to TWO decimal places)

Solve for $x$ and $y$ simultaneously:

$x+2=2y$ and $\dfrac{1}{x}+\dfrac{1}{y}=1$

Given: $2^{m+1}+2^{m}=3^{n+2}-3^{n}$ where $m$ and $n$ are integers.

Determine the value of $m+n$.
questions.notes: No dedicated skill for equating bases after factoring an exponential equation to find the integer exponents; tagged with exp.laws-of-exponents.

questions.text_md: Determine the value of $T_{91}$
Calculate $S_{91}$
Calculate the value of $n$ for which $T_{n}=517$

questions.stem_md:
The following information is given about a quadratic number pattern:

$T_{1}=3$, $T_{2}-T_{1}=9$ and $T_{3}-T_{2}=21$

questions.text_md: Show that $T_{5}=111$
Show that the general term of the quadratic pattern is $T_{n}=6n^{2}-9n+6$
Show that the pattern is increasing for all $n\in N$.
questions.notes: No dedicated skill for showing that a quadratic pattern is increasing; tagged with seq.quadratic-general-term (the first difference $T_n'=12n-9$ is positive for all $n\in N$).

questions.stem_md: Given the geometric series: $3+6+12+\dots$  to $n$ terms.

questions.text_md: Write down the general term of this series.
Calculate the value of $k$ such that: $\displaystyle\sum_{p=1}^{k}\dfrac{3}{2}(2)^{p}=98\,301$

A geometric sequence and an arithmetic sequence have the same first term.

- The common ratio of the geometric sequence is $\dfrac{1}{3}$
- The common difference of the arithmetic sequence is $3$
- The sum of $22$ terms of the arithmetic sequence is $734$ more than the sum to infinity of the geometric sequence.

Calculate the value of the first term.

questions.stem_md:
Sketched below is the graph of $f(x)=2^{x}-4$  for $x\in[-2\,;\,4)$.
A and B are respectively the $y$- and $x$-intercepts of $f$.

questions.text_md: Write down the equation of the asymptote of $f$.
Determine the coordinates of B.
Determine the equation of $k$, a straight line passing through A and B in the form $k(x)=\dots$
Calculate the vertical distance between $k$ and $f$ at $x=1$
Write down the equation of $g$ if it is given that $g(x)=f(x)+4$
Write down the domain of $g^{-1}$.
Write down the equation of $g^{-1}$ in the form $y=\dots$

questions.stem_md: The graphs of $f(x)=-\dfrac{1}{2}(x-1)^{2}+8$ and $g(x)=\dfrac{d}{x}$ are drawn below. A point of intersection of $f$ and $g$ is B, the turning point of $f$. The graph $f$ has $x$-intercepts at $(-3\,;\,0)$ and $(5\,;\,0)$ and a $y$-intercept at C.

questions.text_md: Write down the coordinates of the turning point of $f$.
Calculate the coordinates of C.
Calculate the value of $d$.
Write down the range of $g$.
For which values of $x$ will $f(x)\cdot g(x)\leq 0$?
Calculate the values of $k$ so that $h(x)=-2x+k$ will not intersect the graph of $g$.
$h$ is a tangent to $g$ at R, a point in the first quadrant. Calculate $t$ such that $y=f(x)+t$ intersects $g$ at R.

questions.stem_md: Patrick deposited an amount of R18 500 into an account earning $r$% interest p.a., compounded monthly. After 6 months, his balance was R19 319,48.

questions.text_md: Calculate the value of $r$.
Calculate the effective interest rate.

questions.stem_md: Kuda bought a laptop for R10 000 on 31 January 2019. He will replace it with a new one in 5 years' time on 31 January 2024.

questions.text_md: The value of the old laptop depreciates annually at a rate of 20% p.a. according to the straight-line method. After how many years will the laptop have a value of R0?

Kuda will buy a laptop that costs R20 000. In order to cover the cost price, he made his first monthly deposit into a savings account on 28 February 2019. He will make his $60^{\text{th}}$ monthly deposit on 31 January 2024. The savings account pays interest at 8,7% p.a., compounded monthly. Calculate Kuda's monthly deposit into this account.

Tino wins a jackpot of R1 600 000. He invests all of his winnings in a fund that earns interest of 11,2% p.a., compounded monthly. He withdraws R20 000 from the fund at the end of each month. His first withdrawal is exactly 1 month after his initial investment. How many withdrawals of R20 000 will Tino be able to make from this fund?
Determine $f'(x)$ from first principles if $f(x)=-4x^{2}$
For which values of $x$ will the tangent to $f(x)=-2x^{3}+8x$ have a positive gradient?
questions.notes: No dedicated skill for the sign of $f'(x)$; tagged with calc.power-rule and alg.quadratic-inequality.

questions.text_md: Determine the coordinates of the turning points of $f$.
Draw a sketch graph of $f$. Clearly label all the intercepts with the axes and any turning points.
Use the graph to determine the value(s) of $k$ for which $-x^{3}+6x^{2}-9x+4=k$ will have three real and unequal roots.
questions.notes: Printed as "the value(s) of $k$"; the answer is an interval of values of $k$.

questions.text_md: The line $g(x)=ax+b$ is the tangent to $f$ at the point of inflection of $f$. Determine the equation of $g$.
Calculate the value of $\theta$, the acute angle formed between $g$ and the $x$-axis in the first quadrant.

questions.stem_md: The diagram below represents a printed poster. Rectangle ABCD is the part on which the text is printed. This shaded area ABCD is 432 cm$^{2}$ and AD $=x$ cm. ABCD is 4 cm from the left and right edges of the page and 3 cm from the top and bottom of the page.

questions.text_md:
Show that the total area of the page is given by:

$A(x)=\dfrac{3\,456}{x}+6x+480$
Determine the value of $x$ such that the total area of the page is a minimum.

questions.stem_md:
A and B are independent events. $P(A)=\dfrac{1}{3}$ and $P(B)=\dfrac{3}{4}$

Determine:

questions.text_md: P(A and B)
P(at least ONE event occurs)

questions.stem_md:
The probability that it will snow on the Drakensberg Mountains in June is 5%.

- When it snows on the mountains, the probability that the minimum temperature in Central South Africa will drop below 0 °C is 72%.
- If it does not snow on the mountains, the probability that the minimum temperature in Central South Africa will drop below 0 °C is 35%.

questions.text_md: Represent the given information on a tree diagram. Clearly indicate the probabilities associated with EACH branch.
Calculate the probability that the temperature in Central South Africa will NOT drop below 0 °C in June 2024.

questions.stem_md: Ten learners stand randomly in a line, one behind the other.

questions.text_md: In how many different ways can the ten learners stand in the line?
Calculate the probability that there will be 5 learners between the 2 youngest learners in the line.

figures.caption: Parabola $f(x)=-\frac{1}{2}(x-1)^{2}+8$ with $x$-intercepts at $(-3\,;\,0)$ and $(5\,;\,0)$, $y$-intercept C and turning point B, and the hyperbola $g(x)=d/x$ intersecting $f$ at B.

points.label: B
points.note: B is described as the turning point of f and a point of intersection of f and g; its coordinates are asked in 5.1.

figures.notes: d=8 is derived in 5.3 from B(1 ; 8) lying on g. C is (0 ; 15/2). Diagram not to scale.
